classes.name: HttpService
classes.doc: JSON, GUIDs and URL encoding. Web requests need the network and raise RE9002.

properties.name: HttpEnabled
properties.doc: Whether web requests are allowed; they are never available offline.

methods.name: GenerateGUID
methods.doc: A new random GUID, in braces unless wrapInCurlyBraces is false. The sequence follows the run seed.

methods.name: JSONEncode
methods.doc: The JSON text of a value. An empty table is an empty array; a table with keys 1 to n is an array and one with string keys an object. Other tables, functions and non-finite numbers raise RE3006.

methods.name: JSONDecode
methods.doc: The value of a JSON text: objects and arrays become tables, null becomes nil.

methods.name: UrlEncode
methods.doc: The text with every character other than letters, digits and -_.~ percent-encoded.

methods.name: GetAsync
methods.doc: Needs an online service; raises RE9002 at once.

methods.name: PostAsync
methods.doc: Needs an online service; raises RE9002 at once.

methods.name: RequestAsync
methods.doc: Needs an online service; raises RE9002 at once.

properties.name: MaxItems
properties.doc: The most instances waiting at once; adding more destroys the oldest early.

methods.name: AddItem
methods.doc: Destroys the instance after lifetime seconds (10 when left out) of simulation time.

classes.name: ProximityPromptService
classes.doc: Chooses which proximity prompts each client shows and reports their activity.

properties.name: Enabled
properties.doc: When false, no prompt is shown.

properties.name: MaxPromptsVisible
properties.doc: The most prompts shown at once.

events.name: PromptShown
events.doc: Fires on the client when a prompt is shown.

events.name: PromptHidden
events.doc: Fires on the client when a prompt is hidden.

events.name: PromptTriggered
events.doc: Fires when a player activates a prompt.

events.name: PromptTriggerEnded
events.doc: Fires when a player lets go after activating a prompt.

events.name: PromptButtonHoldBegan
events.doc: Fires when a player starts holding a prompt's key.

events.name: PromptButtonHoldEnded
events.doc: Fires when a player lets go before a hold completed.

classes.name: ProximityPrompt
classes.note: RequiresLineOfSight is not checked yet, and prompts are not drawn; activation is through InputHoldBegin and InputHoldEnd (input binding is the input work's).
classes.doc: An action a player can take near a part or attachment. The client shows the nearest enabled prompt within MaxActivationDistance of its character for each key; InputHoldBegin and InputHoldEnd press and release it.

properties.name: ActionText
properties.doc: What the prompt does, such as Open.

properties.name: ObjectText
properties.doc: What the prompt acts on.

properties.name: Enabled
properties.doc: When false, the prompt is never shown.

properties.name: HoldDuration
properties.doc: Seconds the key must be held before the prompt triggers; 0 triggers on press.

properties.name: MaxActivationDistance
properties.doc: How near the character must be, in studs.

properties.name: KeyboardKeyCode
properties.doc: The key that activates the prompt.

properties.name: GamepadKeyCode
properties.doc: The gamepad button that activates the prompt.

properties.name: RequiresLineOfSight
properties.note: Stored but not checked: there is no line-of-sight test yet.
properties.doc: When true, the prompt needs a clear line to the character.

properties.name: Exclusivity
properties.doc: Whether the prompt competes with others on the same key, with all prompts, or never.

properties.name: Style
properties.doc: Whether the built-in look or a game's own interface shows the prompt.

properties.name: UIOffset
properties.doc: Where the prompt's interface sits relative to its position, in pixels.

properties.name: ClickablePrompt
properties.doc: Whether the prompt can be clicked or tapped.

properties.name: AutoLocalize
properties.doc: Whether the prompt's texts are translated.

methods.name: InputHoldBegin
methods.doc: Starts holding the prompt for the local player, as pressing its key does. Client only; the prompt must be shown.

methods.name: InputHoldEnd
methods.doc: Stops holding the prompt for the local player. Client only.

events.name: Triggered
events.doc: Fires on the server and on the triggering client when the prompt is activated, with the player.

events.name: TriggerEnded
events.doc: Fires when the player lets go after triggering.

events.name: PromptButtonHoldBegan
events.doc: Fires when the player starts holding the prompt's key, for a prompt with a HoldDuration.

events.name: PromptButtonHoldEnded
events.doc: Fires when the player lets go before the hold completed.

events.name: PromptShown
events.doc: Fires on the client when the prompt becomes the one shown for its key.

events.name: PromptHidden
events.doc: Fires on the client when the prompt stops being shown.

classes.name: TextChatService
classes.note: Only commands and Player.Chatted; there are no channels, bubbles or chat window.
classes.doc: The chat system. The harness's say sends a message as a player: Player.Chatted fires, and a message that starts with a TextChatCommand's alias triggers it.

properties.name: ChatVersion
properties.doc: Which chat system the place uses.

properties.name: CreateDefaultCommands
properties.doc: Whether the built-in commands are made.

properties.name: CreateDefaultTextChannels
properties.doc: Whether the built-in channels are made.

classes.name: TextChatCommand
classes.doc: A chat command: a message whose first word is PrimaryAlias or SecondaryAlias (ignoring case) triggers it.

properties.name: PrimaryAlias
properties.doc: The command's main word, such as /help.

properties.name: SecondaryAlias
properties.doc: Another word that triggers the command.

properties.name: Enabled
properties.doc: When false, the command never triggers.

properties.name: AutocompleteVisible
properties.doc: Whether chat suggests the command.

events.name: Triggered
events.doc: Fires on the server and on the sending client with the sender's TextSource and the whole message.

classes.name: TextChannel
classes.note: Only holds the TextSources; sending and receiving messages through a channel is not implemented.
classes.doc: A chat channel, holding a TextSource per player who can speak in it.

classes.name: TextSource
classes.doc: A player's membership of a chat channel.

properties.name: UserId
properties.doc: The player's UserId.

properties.name: CanSend
properties.doc: Whether the player may send messages in the channel.

classes.name: GuiService
classes.doc: Facts about the screen layout and the selected interface object.

properties.name: SelectedObject
properties.doc: The interface object selected for gamepad navigation, or nil.

properties.name: AutoSelectGuiEnabled
properties.doc: Whether the gamepad selection button picks an object by itself.

properties.name: GuiNavigationEnabled
properties.doc: Whether gamepad navigation of interfaces is on.

properties.name: MenuIsOpen
properties.doc: Whether the system menu is open; it never opens offline.

properties.name: TopbarInset
properties.note: A fixed 58-pixel band from x 0 to 0; there is no top bar or real screen width here.
properties.doc: The screen area the top bar covers.

methods.name: GetGuiInset
methods.note: A fixed top inset of 58 pixels and no bottom inset.
methods.doc: The top-left and bottom-right insets of the screen area interfaces avoid.

events.name: MenuOpened
events.note: Never fires: there is no system menu offline.
events.doc: Fires when the system menu opens.

events.name: MenuClosed
events.note: Never fires: there is no system menu offline.
events.doc: Fires when the system menu closes.

properties.name: ShowDevelopmentGui
properties.doc: Whether StarterGui's contents are shown in the editor.

methods.name: SetCore
methods.note: Values are recorded and read back; nothing is drawn.
methods.doc: Sets a built-in interface option by name. Recorded for this client; the built-in interface is not drawn. Client only.

methods.name: GetCore
methods.note: Reads back what SetCore recorded, else the default of a readable option (ChatActive, TopbarEnabled, the notification and menu switches); raises for options with no readable value offline.
methods.doc: The value of a built-in interface option. Raises for a name the built-in interface does not register. Client only.

methods.name: SetCoreGuiEnabled
methods.note: Recorded; the built-in interface is not drawn.
methods.doc: Turns a part of the built-in interface on or off for this client. Recorded only.

methods.name: GetCoreGuiEnabled
methods.doc: Whether a part of the built-in interface is on for this client.

properties.name: CharacterWalkSpeed
properties.doc: The WalkSpeed new characters start with.

properties.name: CharacterJumpPower
properties.doc: The JumpPower new characters start with.

properties.name: CharacterJumpHeight
properties.doc: The JumpHeight new characters start with.

properties.name: CharacterUseJumpPower
properties.doc: Whether new characters jump by JumpPower rather than JumpHeight.

properties.name: CharacterMaxSlopeAngle
properties.doc: The steepest slope new characters can walk up, in degrees.

properties.name: AutoJumpEnabled
properties.doc: Whether characters jump over obstacles by themselves on touch devices.

properties.name: EnableMouseLockOption
properties.doc: Whether players may switch to mouse lock.

properties.name: CameraMaxZoomDistance
properties.doc: The farthest the default camera zooms out.

properties.name: CameraMinZoomDistance
properties.doc: The nearest the default camera zooms in.

properties.name: CameraMode
properties.doc: Whether the default camera is free or locked in first person.

properties.name: HealthDisplayDistance
properties.doc: How far away players see other characters' health.

properties.name: NameDisplayDistance
properties.doc: How far away players see other characters' names.

properties.name: LoadCharacterAppearance
properties.doc: Whether characters take their account's look.

classes.name: SoundService
classes.note: Properties only; playing sounds is the sound work's.
classes.doc: Settings for how sound is played in the place.

properties.name: AmbientReverb
properties.doc: The reverb applied to every sound.

properties.name: DistanceFactor
properties.doc: Studs per metre for 3D sound.

properties.name: DopplerScale
properties.doc: How strongly motion changes pitch.

properties.name: RolloffScale
properties.doc: How fast 3D sounds fade with distance.

properties.name: RespectFilteringEnabled
properties.doc: Whether sounds a client plays stay on that client.
